faq.q: What is it like to live near Mount Athos?
faq.a: Quiet and close to nature. The villages near Mount Athos have a calm atmosphere, clear water and green hills. Visitors come mainly in summer, and outside the season life is local and slow. It suits buyers who value peace over nightlife.

faq.q: Is Ierissos busy all year round?
faq.a: Yes. Ierissos is a working town with a permanent population, so shops, tavernas, the harbour and services stay open through the winter. Summer adds visitors to its long beach, but the town does not depend only on tourism. It is a good base for life all year.

faq.q: Can I buy a holiday home near Ouranoupoli?
faq.a: Yes. Holiday homes and apartments in and around Ouranoupoli and the nearby coast come up for sale. Property inside Mount Athos cannot be bought, but the villages outside it are open to all buyers. Ask us about current homes in the area.

intro: Ierissos real estate and homes across the municipality of Aristotelis, in north-east Halkidiki on the third peninsula. This is a quieter, more local part of Halkidiki, with working towns, clear water and the mountains of Mount Athos on the horizon. Every listing below is in the municipality of Aristotelis. Book a viewing in person or by video. Ierissos and Ouranoupoli are the best-known places in the area.
body:
Living in Aristotelis

Aristotelis feels less touristy than Kassandra or Sithonia. Towns such as Ierissos stay alive all year, while summer brings visitors to the beaches and small resorts. It suits buyers who prefer local life to busy resorts.

Ierissos: a working fishing town

Ierissos is a fishing town with a long sandy beach, a harbour and a tradition of wooden boat-building. Shops, tavernas and services stay open outside the season.

Ouranoupoli and the Mount Athos area

Ouranoupoli is the last village before Mount Athos and the starting point for boat trips along its coast. Mount Athos itself is a monastic state that only men may visit, with a permit, and property there cannot be bought. Our listings are in the villages outside it.

Homes and land for sale in Aristotelis

Houses, apartments and plots are listed across the municipality, from seaside villages to green hills inland. Homes in the towns suit year-round life, while plots on the hills offer space and views. Before buying land, have an engineer confirm what can be built. Filter by type and price to compare.

Getting there from Thessaloniki

Aristotelis is reached by road from Thessaloniki through inland Halkidiki. The drive is longer than to Kassandra, so check the travel time to the home you like before you decide. Many owners see the longer drive as part of the appeal: it keeps the area calm, even in August.
